Description
Grachtveld Mobility operates shared e-bikes and e-mopeds in 38 cities in the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany. Every day more than 120,000 rides generate data on demand, battery levels, repairs and pricing, and our 22-person data team turns this data into decisions: where to place vehicles, when to swap batteries and what a ride should cost.

Our Head of Data has left the company and we have started the search for a permanent successor. Until that person is on board, we are looking for an experienced interim leader for the data team.

Your tasks
- Lead the data team (data engineering, analytics engineering, BI and data science) through three team leads
- Review and prioritise the data roadmap together with the COO, the CFO and the product teams
- Keep our platform (Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Looker) stable and cost-efficient, and decide on the planned move of the streaming pipeline
- Set up data governance and data ownership, including GDPR-compliant handling of location data
- Bring the dynamic pricing and fleet rebalancing models into production with the data science team
- Support the hiring of the permanent Head of Data and hand over in a structured way

Your profile
- 12+ years in data and analytics, of which at least 5 years leading data teams of 15 people or more
- Hands-on knowledge of a modern data stack, ideally Snowflake and dbt
- Experience in a B2C, mobility or marketplace business is a plus
- Strong stakeholder management up to C-level
- Fluent English; Dutch or German is nice to have

Conditions
- Start: 1 November 2026, duration 9 months
- Fully remote from anywhere in the EU; one team week per quarter in Amsterdam, travel costs paid by us
- Day rate: EUR 1,250, excluding VAT
- Freelance contract, invoicing monthly; we can only contract freelancers based in the EU
